articles.symptom: "Payment failed (APX-4021)" at checkout although UPI request was debited.
articles.cause: UPI mandate succeeded at the bank but the payment-gateway callback to Apex timed out, so the order was not created.
articles.fix_steps: 1. Ask the customer to check their bank app for a pending mandate and reverse it if present. 2. Retry checkout with the same UPI handle on a new payment attempt. 3. If the debit repeats twice, raise a payment-fraud-safe request with urgency=high and emergency_type=payment_fraud. 4. Never ask the customer to share a UPI PIN, OTP or CVV.

articles.symptom: "Invalid credentials (APX-4150)" although the customer is sure the password is right.
articles.cause: The account got soft-locked after 5 failed attempts, or OTP is going to a stale phone number.
articles.fix_steps: 1. Confirm the email on file with list_customer_orders. 2. Trigger "Forgot password" and ask the customer to read the 6-digit OTP to the agent. 3. If the lock persists after a correct OTP, create an account_access request with urgency=normal. 4. Never ask for the password itself and never read back an OTP the customer did not volunteer.

articles.symptom: "Return not eligible (APX-4210)" for an item delivered 15 days ago.
articles.cause: The item is outside the 14-day return window, or the category is non-returnable (perishables, innerwear, already-opened personal care).
articles.fix_steps: 1. Read the delivered_at date from lookup_order and explain the 14-day window. 2. Check the product category - grocery/perishables and personal care are non-returnable. 3. If the item is defective, treat it as a product_defect request instead of a return. 4. Escalate to the Quality Desk only when the customer supplies a defect description.

texts.author: support_agent
texts.text:
I am sorry you are experiencing this issue. We are currently seeing elevated UPI callback latency, which is causing the APX-4021 error you mentioned.

Please follow these steps to resolve this:
1. Check your bank app to see if there is a pending mandate. If so, please reverse it.
2. Please do not retry the checkout immediately while the service is degraded.

Since your money was debited, I need to transfer you to our orders team to ensure your payment is tracked correctly and to assist with any refund if necessary.

texts.author: orders_agent
texts.text:
I understand how frustrating it is to have your money debited without an order being created. I am here to help you get this resolved.

Since our payment systems are currently experiencing some latency, please check your bank app to see if there is a pending mandate. If you find one, please reverse it. 

To ensure we track this payment correctly and assist you further, could you please provide me with your registered email address? I will then be able to look into this for you. Please remember, never share your UPI PIN, OTP, or CVV with anyone.
